mapper.insert: insert into device ( device_code, device_name, category, lab_id, location, owner_user_id, status, health, online, specs, purchase_date, inventory_date, warranty_date, usage_hours, maintenance ) values( #{deviceCode}, #{deviceName}, #{category}, #{labId}, #{location}, #{ownerUserId}, #{status}, #{health}, #{online}, #{specs}, #{purchaseDate}, #{inventoryDate}, #{warrantyDate}, #{usageHours}, #{maintenance} )
mapper.update: update device set device_code = #{devices.deviceCode}, device_name = #{devices.deviceName}, category = #{devices.category}, lab_id = #{devices.labId}, location = #{devices.location}, owner_user_id = #{devices.ownerUserId}, status = #{devices.status}, health = #{devices.health}, online = #{devices.online}, specs = #{devices.specs}, purchase_date = #{devices.purchaseDate}, inventory_date = #{devices.inventoryDate}, warranty_date = #{devices.warrantyDate}, usage_hours = #{devices.usageHours}, maintenance = #{devices.maintenance}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}

update device set status = #{status}, health = #{health}, online = #{online}, maintenance = trim(concat(coalesce(maintenance, ''), '\n', #{maintenance})), updated_at = now() where device_name = #{device} or device_code = #{device}
mapper.sql: d.id, d.device_code as deviceCode, d.device_name as deviceName, d.category, d.lab_id as labId, l.lab_name as labName, d.location, d.owner_user_id as ownerUserId, coalesce(u.real_name, u.username) as ownerUsername, d.status, d.health, d.online, d.specs, d.purchase_date as purchaseDate, d.inventory_date as inventoryDate, d.warranty_date as warrantyDate, d.usage_hours as usageHours, d.maintenance, d.created_at as createdAt, d.updated_at as updatedAt
mapper.select:
select
from device d left join lab l on d.lab_id = l.id left join sys_user u on u.id = d.owner_user_id order by d.id

select
from device d left join lab l on d.lab_id = l.id left join sys_user u on u.id = d.owner_user_id where d.id = #{id}

select d.id, d.device_code AS deviceCode, d.device_name AS deviceName, d.category, d.lab_id AS labId, l.lab_name AS labName, d.location, d.owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, u.username AS ownerUsername, d.status, d.health, d.online, d.specs, d.purchase_date AS purchaseDate, d.inventory_date AS inventoryDate, d.warranty_date AS warrantyDate, d.usage_hours AS usageHours, d.maintenance, d.created_at AS createdAt, d.updated_at AS updatedAt from device as d left join sys_user u on d.owner_user_id = u.id left join lab l on d.lab_id = l.id where lab_id = #{labId}
